values.title: Partnership over transactions
values.description: We win when you win. That means honest advice even when it costs us billable hours — and saying "don't build this" when the math doesn't work.

values.title: Pragmatic innovation
values.description: We adopt new technology when it serves the product, never to pad a résumé. Boring tech that ships beats exciting tech that doesn't.

values.title: Velocity with quality
values.description: Speed is a feature, but rework is the enemy of speed. Small batches, automated tests and weekly demos keep us fast and correct.

values.title: Radical transparency
values.description: You see what we see: open backlogs, shared Slack channels and honest demos — including the stuff that didn't go to plan.

milestones.title: Founded in San Francisco
milestones.description: Elena and Daniel leave their respective startups to start a consultancy built around small senior teams and weekly shipping.

milestones.title: First enterprise engagement
milestones.description: A payments-platform rebuild for PayNorth becomes our first seven-figure contract — and still our longest-running client relationship.

milestones.title: 50th project delivered
milestones.description: The team grows past 20 specialists and formalizes its discovery-phase methodology after seeing its impact across engagements.

milestones.title: Remote-first, worldwide
milestones.description: We go fully remote-first and open a European hub in Lisbon, extending coverage across time zones for support and delivery.

milestones.title: SOC 2 Type II certification
milestones.description: Formalizing the security practices our regulated clients already trusted us with opens doors in healthcare and finance.

milestones.title: 120+ projects and counting
milestones.description: A 40-person team of engineers, designers and strategists serving clients across four continents.
